senses.gloss: m. (v. מְצַע; √מץ; cmp. b. h. תָּוֶךְ, תֹּךְ, תְּכָכִים) [lying in a press], whence—בא׳ in the centre, between two extremes.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Chagigah 2:1:6">Y. Ḥag. II, 77ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>יהלך בא׳</he> he must walk between the extremes.
B. Mets. 70ᵇ יד הנכרי בא׳; Y. Ab. Zar. I, 40ᵃ top אצבע הגוי בא׳ the hand [finger] of the gentile is between, i.e. he has a share in it; a. fr.—2) common fund, estate.
<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Batra 10:7">B. Bath. X, 7</cite> <he>השכר לא׳</he> the profit belongs to the common fund.
<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Batra 9:3">Ib. IX, 3</cite> <he>השביחו לא׳</he> they improved for the common fund, i.e. the profit must be equally divided.
<cite ref="Bava Batra 144b:8">Ib. 144ᵇ</cite> <he>מן הא׳</he> from the estate; a. fr. Cmp. <cite ref="M02340"><he>מְצַע</he></cite>, <cite ref="M01241"><he>מִיסְוָון</he></cite>.—[Also in Ch.
Targ. Job II, 8 (Ms. מצע) Targ. Y. II, Num. XXII, 24 בא׳ between.]
